editorial_note: Wording was edited for clarity in this public version. All numerical settings, identifiers and decisions are unchanged from the frozen production contract.

interpretation_boundary.note: Figure 2 evaluates a compact M=4,S=1,H=12 reporting-rule instance under an abstract standardized root-utility law. Empirical construction sensitivity is evaluated separately in Figures 3 and 4; these simulated power, abstention and arithmetic-support rates are not transported to an M8 or multi-construction family.

family.directional_hypothesis_template: For ordered direction Mi_GT_Mj, the exact sign test targets the rootwise strong null H_ij: theta_ij,r<=0.5 at every specified root position r, against violation of that intersection null. The design-averaged theta_ij is descriptive and does not by itself define the exact-test null.
family.multiplicity_target: The 12 directional statements are the claim family. The reverse directions are retained because a false directional claim, rather than merely a difference claim, is the error target; no six-pair or two-sided-family reinterpretation is authorized.

expansion_rule.matched_root_deletion_interpretation: For scientific endpoints based only on the non-tied available-root signs and K, each listed TIE/MISS pair has the same probability law because both independently delete a complete root from analysis at the same rate. They are a mechanism-label metamorphic QA, not evidence that tying and missingness have distinguishable endpoint effects; their ledger availability/tie fields remain different.
expansion_rule.interaction_claim_boundary: This is one-factor-at-a-time only. It contains no tie-by-missing, tie-by-support, missing-by-support or three-way cell and cannot support a combined-nuisance robustness or interaction claim.
expansion_rule.derivation: 7 effects x 4 root counts x [1 baseline + 3 nonbaseline tie + 3 nonbaseline missing + 3 nonbaseline support] = 280 unique cells; delta=0 contributes 1 x 4 x 10 = 40 cells and the six nonzero deltas contribute 6 x 4 x 10 = 240 cells
expansion_rule.uniqueness_rule: Generate the BASE cell once per delta-by-R combination; nonbaseline arms replace exactly one baseline axis and may not duplicate BASE or combine two nonbaseline axes.
expansion_rule.cell_output_order: standardized_effect_delta order, then root_count_R order, then axis_variant_order
expansion_rule.cell_manifest_serialization: UTF-8 TSV, one header, LF line endings, no BOM and terminal LF; cell_order is 1-based; rows follow cell_output_order and exact generator formatting.
expansion_rule.cell_manifest_digest_strategy: The outcome-free generator derives rows from this contract, verifies exactly 280 unique cell_id, 280 unique 128-bit seeds and 40 global-null cells, and emits deterministic bytes. Its --check mode must pass in the locked environment before production; the manifest/generator byte counts and SHA-256 values above must also be bound by the activation receipt.

data_generating_law.root_support_assignment: n_r is the root_support_pattern cycle repeated in root-index order; every authorized R is an integer multiple of every cycle length
data_generating_law.root_support_role: n_r controls only descendant-task averaging variance inside a root; descendant tasks are not independent evidence units and never replace R in the sign procedure
data_generating_law.ordered_pair_mean_difference: mu_i(delta)-mu_j(delta)=delta*(c_i-c_j), with c=[1.5,0.5,-0.5,-1.5]; adjacent true directions have magnitude |delta|, distance-two pairs 2|delta| and the M0/M3 pair 3|delta|
numeric_implementation_order: Create c=np.asarray([1.5,0.5,-0.5,-1.5],dtype=float64), n=np.asarray(expanded support cycle,dtype=float64), and mu=np.float64(delta)*c.
Create U=(mu[None,None,:] + A) + Ebar with exactly this parenthesization.
Create tied_mean=np.mean(U,axis=2,dtype=float64,keepdims=True), then U=np.where(tie_mask[:,:,None],tied_mean,U). No in-place alternate reduction is authorized.
Apply missing_mask and tie_mask only through analysis_root_mask; do not compact or reorder the root axis.
data_generating_law.standardization_identity: For BALANCED_8, Var(U_ri-U_rj)=0.8+1.6/8=1 for every i!=j; therefore |delta| is the balanced-root pair-difference SD magnitude only for adjacent model pairs.
data_generating_law.standardization_limit: delta is not one common standardized effect for all six unordered pairs or for heterogeneous n_r. Pair-specific root-r standardized mean difference is delta*(c_i-c_j)/sqrt(0.8+1.6/n_r).
data_generating_law.support_stress_interpretation: All support cycles have arithmetic mean n_r=8, but they do not hold mean(1/n_r) or average pair-difference variance fixed. Average Var(U_i-U_j) is 1,76/75,16/15 and 124/75 for BALANCED_8,MILD_6_10,MODERATE_4_12 and SEVERE_1_15. Thus this axis intentionally combines support heterogeneity with reduced average precision and must not be described as pure imbalance at constant information.
data_generating_law.conditional_pair_probability: For a non-tied available root at fixed n_r, theta_ij,r=Phi(delta*(c_i-c_j)/sqrt(0.8+1.6/n_r)); independent tie and missing events do not change this conditional probability.
data_generating_law.effect_interpretation: dimensionless simulation parameter only; not a biological effect, clinically meaningful threshold, SESOI or common effect size for all family edges

tie_mechanism.event: one Bernoulli(tie_probability) event independently for each replicate and root
tie_mechanism.mask_rule: tie_mask = (tie_uniform < tie_probability); equality at the probability boundary is not a tie
tie_mechanism.action_when_true: replace all four U_rm values by their arithmetic mean computed before replacement
tie_mechanism.truth_definition: delta and the non-tied generating law continue to define the ordered truth
tie_mechanism.incidental_zero_policy: For a root with tie_mask=false, every one of the six pair differences must be nonzero in float64. Any literal zero is NUMERIC_DEGENERACY_FAILURE for the replicate; it may not create pair-specific K or be silently treated as an induced tie.

missingness_mechanism.event: one Bernoulli(complete_root_mcar_missing_probability) event independently for each replicate and root
missingness_mechanism.mask_rule: missing_mask = (missing_uniform < complete_root_mcar_missing_probability); equality at the probability boundary is not missing
missingness_mechanism.action_when_true: remove the complete four-model root vector before testing

estimand_registry.design_averaged_estimand: theta_ij=(1/R)*sum_r theta_ij,r over the fixed root-support sequence
estimand_registry.availability_weighting: Because tie and missing probabilities are common across roots and independent of utilities and n_r, conditioning on non-tied availability preserves uniform weighting over the R specified root positions.
estimand_registry.operating_characteristic_target: Endpoint probabilities average over generated utilities, ties and missing observations, including structurally withheld outcomes. They describe this simulation law and do not estimate biological performance.

truth_registry.truth_basis: Truth is defined by whether every root-specific theta_ij,r is greater than 0.5 under the non-tied law; support, MCAR missingness and independent induced ties change power/withholding but not direction truth.

randomness.cell_seed_derivation: digest=SHA256(UTF8(namespace) || one byte 0x00 || UTF8(cell_id)) with no newline or terminator; cell_seed is the first 16 digest bytes interpreted as one unsigned big-endian integer
randomness.always_draw_rule: Execute all six draw calls in the frozen order for every cell even when tie_probability=0 or missing_probability=0; never skip, shorten or lazily generate a draw based on an axis value.
randomness.replicate_index_rule: The first array dimension is replicate_index 0,...,4999 in order; indices are never compacted after withhold or failure.
randomness.numeric_dtype_and_layout: All random draws and utility arithmetic are IEEE-754 float64 in C-contiguous arrays; uniforms use Generator.random(...,dtype=float64); no float32 cast, fast-math, fused alternate implementation or reassociation is authorized.
randomness.cross_cell_seed_relation: Every distinct cell_id, including +delta and -delta partners, has its own independently derived seed namespace. Common random numbers are not used, and opposite-sign production cells are not expected to be byte-identical or numerically equal.

rng_known_answer_test.stream_boundary: Run the KAT on an independent fresh bit generator. It must not advance, replace or share the production Generator stream for this or any other cell.

randomness.state_audit: Record cell_id, decimal cell_seed, full initial PCG64DXSM state, full final state, NumPy version, Python version, byte order, platform and locked-environment receipt hash without recording outcome values.
randomness.byte_identity_boundary: Public byte identity requires the same cell enumeration, NumPy 1.26.4, immutable environment, arithmetic implementation, serializer and platform class; a statistically equivalent generator or seed API is not a replay.

reporting_rule.estimand: For ordered pair i,j, descriptive theta_ij=(1/R)*sum_r theta_ij,r over the fixed support sequence, where theta_ij,r=P(U_ri>U_rj | tie_mask=false, missing_mask=false,n_r). Exact testing targets the stronger intersection null theta_ij,r<=0.5 for every r, not merely theta_ij<=0.5.
reporting_rule.analysis_root_mask: analysis_root_mask = not missing_mask and not tie_mask; because both masks act on the complete four-model vector, the same K is used for all 12 directions.
reporting_rule.tie_rule: All tie_mask=true roots are excluded from every W,L,K and retained in the ledger. A literal float64 zero on tie_mask=false is NUMERIC_DEGENERACY_FAILURE, not a pair-specific tie.
reporting_rule.count_rule: For Mi_GT_Mj, W_ij=sum over analysis roots of I(U_i>U_j), L_ij=sum I(U_i<U_j), and K=W_ij+L_ij=sum(analysis_root_mask). Require W_ij=L_ji, L_ij=W_ji and one common K across all directions.
reporting_rule.per_direction_p_value: Let N_ij=sum_{w=W_ij}^{K} choose(K,w) as an exact nonnegative integer. The one-sided fair-binomial p value is N_ij/2^K; integer N_ij and K are the decision authority and float64 p is display only.
reporting_rule.nonidentical_root_exactness: Conditional on any realized analysis-root mask, signs are independent but may be non-identically distributed when n_r varies. Under the rootwise strong null every retained success probability is <=0.5, so W is stochastically dominated by Binomial(K,0.5) and the fair-binomial upper tail is valid. No claim of exact testing for the weaker average-null theta_ij<=0.5 is authorized.
reporting_rule.multiplicity: Holm step-down over all 12 ordered directions. Sort by the exact rational p value, breaking exact p ties by ordered_direction_order; at sorted step s=1,...,12 reject only if 20*N_(s)*(12-s+1)<=2^K, and stop at the first failure. Reject exactly the uninterrupted prefix; no later hypothesis can be rejected after a stop.
reporting_rule.Kmin_derivation: ceil(log2(12/0.05))=ceil(log2(240))=8; at K=7 the minimum p=1/128 exceeds 1/240, while at K=8 the minimum p=1/256 is at most 1/240.
reporting_rule.Kmin_interpretation: Kmin=8 is only the arithmetic minimum at which any first Holm rejection is possible; it is not a claim of adequate biological sample size, power or root support.
reporting_rule.Kmin_family_scope: The value 8 applies only to this M=4,H=12,alpha=0.05 family. For any other H recompute ceil(log2(H/alpha)); for illustration H=56 and H=90 require 11, while H=168 requires 12. No M8 or multi-construction procedure may inherit Kmin=8.
reporting_rule.structural_withhold: If common non-tied available K<8, return no direction and STRUCTURAL_WITHHOLD_ARITHMETIC; do not run a reduced family.
reporting_rule.decision_abstention: If K>=8 and Holm rejects no ordered direction, return no direction and DECISION_ABSTENTION_NO_REJECTION.
reporting_rule.state_partition: With zero execution failures, every replicate is in exactly one of: STRUCTURAL_WITHHOLD_ARITHMETIC (K<8); DECISION_ABSTENTION_NO_REJECTION (K>=8 and empty rejection set); or NONEMPTY_DIRECTION_SET (K>=8 and one or more Holm rejections).
family_assertions: No accepted replicate may reject both directions of the same unordered model pair.
For delta!=0, exact-family recovery is true if and only if true_positive_edge_count=6 and false_positive_edge_count=0.
Any assertion failure is HOLM_INVARIANT_FAILURE and invalidates the complete cell.

registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

registered_endpoints.definition: proportion of replicates whose rejected-direction set equals the six alternative directions specified by the simulation
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

registered_endpoints.definition: proportion of replicates with at least one rejected null direction specified by the simulation
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

registered_endpoints.definition: proportion of replicates with an empty rejected-direction set
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

registered_endpoints.definition: proportion of replicates with K<8 and the frozen structural reason
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell

registered_endpoints.definition: For each replicate, divide the number of rejected alternative directions specified by the simulation by six, assigning zero to structural withholding or decision abstention; report the mean of this bounded replicate-level score.
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

registered_endpoints.definition: For each replicate, divide the number of rejected null directions specified by the simulation by 12 when delta=0 and by six when delta!=0, assigning zero to structural withholding or decision abstention; report the mean of this bounded replicate-level score.
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

registered_endpoints.definition: proportion with K>=8 and no Holm rejection
registered_endpoints.denominator: 5,000 simulated replicates in an accepted zero-failure cell, including structurally withheld outcomes

monte_carlo_reporting.accepted_cell_scientific_denominator: exactly 5,000 simulated replicates; structurally withheld outcomes remain in this denominator
monte_carlo_reporting.failure_rate_denominator: all 5,000 fixed replicate indices; an uncomputed index after cell abort receives a QC failure stub rather than being dropped
monte_carlo_reporting.failed_replicate_endpoint_disposition: Any non-NONE replicate failure code makes the entire cell CELL_FAILED_CLOSED. Withhold every scientific endpoint and interval for that cell; report only failure count, failure-code counts and failure rate. A failed replicate is never encoded as success, abstention, withhold or false-selection zero and is never removed to form a smaller scientific denominator.
monte_carlo_reporting.grid_failure_disposition: The fixed 280-cell grid is incomplete if any cell is CELL_FAILED_CLOSED; Figure 2 and its scientific source table cannot receive terminal acceptance from a partial grid.
monte_carlo_reporting.binary_endpoint_intervals: For binary endpoints, pointwise two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals over n=5000 accepted replicates, with alpha=0.05 and exact boundary handling k=0 or k=n; the locked SciPy implementation/version must be recorded before execution.
monte_carlo_reporting.bounded_mean_endpoint_intervals: For SIM_TRUE_EDGE_RECOVERY and SIM_FALSE_EDGE_SELECTION, use the 5000 independent replicate-level bounded scores and report the pointwise finite-sample 95% Hoeffding interval [max(0,mean-h),min(1,mean+h)] with h=sqrt(log(2/0.05)/(2*5000)). This remains nonzero-width at all-zero/all-one boundaries. Edge observations within a replicate are not treated as independent binomial trials.
monte_carlo_reporting.replicate_count_precision_justification: With 5000 independent simulation replicates, a binary proportion has worst-case Monte Carlo SE sqrt(0.25/5000)=0.0070711 and SE sqrt(0.05*0.95/5000)=0.0030822 at probability 0.05. These are precision calculations, not biological sample-size or power justifications.
monte_carlo_reporting.interval_interpretation: All intervals quantify Monte Carlo estimation error under this simulation law only; they are not root-level, biological, simultaneous or across-cell inferential intervals.
endpoint_algebra_invariants: Within every accepted cell, SIM_NO_DIRECTION_ABSTENTION numerator equals SIM_STRUCTURAL_WITHHOLD numerator plus SIM_DECISION_ABSTENTION numerator.
Within every accepted delta=0 cell, SIM_FWER_GLOBAL_NULL numerator equals SIM_ANY_FALSE_SELECTION numerator.
Within every accepted delta!=0 cell, exact-family recovery is equivalent to true_positive_edge_count=6 and false_positive_edge_count=0.
All endpoint numerators are between 0 and 5000; all replicate-level edge fractions are in [0,1].
monte_carlo_reporting.rounding: display rounding only; source data retains integer counts, denominators and full float64 proportions/limits

root_count_ledger_invariants: 0<=generated_missing_root_count<=R and 0<=generated_tie_root_count<=R; the two generated masks may overlap because missingness is applied after tie generation.
For every zero-failure replicate, W_ij+W_ji=K. When K>=8, all exact binomial numerator entries are integers in [1,2^K]; when K<8, the complete N vector is missing under the structural-withhold rule.
retained_outputs.bitmask_encoding: Bit b (least-significant bit is b=0) corresponds exactly to ordered_direction_order[b]; unused bits above b=11 must be zero.
retained_outputs.failure_code_rule: Accepted cells require failure_code=NONE for all 5000 ledger rows. Any other enumerated code invalidates the complete cell; an unrecognized code is SCHEMA_FAILURE.
retained_outputs.failed_row_NA_rule: When failure_code is not NONE, all scientific fields from structural_withhold through false_positive_edge_count are missing, not zero and not partial. Serialize missing as JSON null and as an empty TSV field; the strings NA/NaN and numeric sentinels are forbidden. Preserve cell_id, replicate_index, auditable pre-failure root-count fields when valid, and failure_code.
retained_outputs.structural_withhold_row_rule: STRUCTURAL_WITHHOLD_ARITHMETIC is not a failure: failure_code=NONE, structural_withhold=true, decision_abstention=false, rejected bitmask=0 and TP/FP counts=0. Record W; store the exact-tail N vector as missing because Holm is not entered at K<8.
retained_outputs.decision_abstention_row_rule: DECISION_ABSTENTION_NO_REJECTION is not a failure: failure_code=NONE, structural_withhold=false, decision_abstention=true, exact W/N vectors are present, rejected bitmask=0 and TP/FP counts=0.

execution_gate.cell_acceptance_rule: A cell has status ACCEPTED only if it contains exactly 5,000 unique replicate_index values (0–4,999), no failures, all invariants pass and its output manifest is complete. Otherwise, it has status CELL_FAILED_CLOSED and contributes no scientific endpoint values.
execution_gate.whole_cell_rerun_rule: No failed replicate may be replaced or appended. After correcting a software or infrastructure problem without changing the fixed scientific contract, rerun the entire cell from replicate_index=0 with the same cell_id and deterministic seed. Retain the failed attempt, record its hash and document the correction.
execution_gate.cell_abort_ledger_rule: If a cell-level exception prevents complete per-replicate evaluation, emit 5,000 QC ledger stubs keyed by the fixed replicate indices, with scientific fields missing and the appropriate failure code. This preserves the 5,000-index denominator without treating uncomputed outcomes as zeros.
execution_gate.complete_grid_acceptance_rule: The complete grid is accepted only if it contains exactly 280 unique accepted cells, 1,400,000 accepted ledger rows, 40 delta=0 cells and 240 delta!=0 cells, with no extra or duplicate cell_id.

direction_label_symmetry_qa.analytic_identity: Under delta -> -delta and model-label reversal M0<->M3,M1<->M2, the generating law, truth family and endpoint distributions are invariant after applying the corresponding ordered-direction permutation.
direction_label_symmetry_qa.required_preproduction_metamorphic_test: On synthetic fixed utility/tie/missing fixtures, reverse model labels and direction bits and require exact mapped equality of W/L/K, integer p numerators, Holm rejection bitmask, truth labels and replicate endpoint scores.
direction_label_symmetry_qa.production_pair_interpretation: +delta and -delta cells have distinct independently derived seeds, so byte equality or exact endpoint equality is prohibited as an acceptance requirement. Post-run signed differences may be reported only as descriptive Monte Carlo QA, never as a tuning trigger or scientific endpoint.

matched_deletion_metamorphic_qa.analytic_identity: At equal deletion probability with all other axes baseline, an induced all-model tie and a completely missing root yield the same scientific-endpoint law because both exclude the complete root from W/L/K.
matched_deletion_metamorphic_qa.required_preproduction_test: Using one synthetic utility fixture and one fixed deletion mask, encode deleted roots once as tie and once as missing; require exact equality of K,W,L,N,Holm bitmask and all scientific replicate scores, while requiring the tie/missing/availability ledger fields to differ as specified.
matched_deletion_metamorphic_qa.production_pair_interpretation: TIE010 versus MISS010 and TIE050 versus MISS050 use distinct cell seeds, so observed Monte Carlo differences are not mechanism effects and exact production equality is not required.

static_preproduction_invariants_required: The standardization and covariance identities in data_generating_law hold algebraically.
The support-pattern mean inverse n and average pair-difference variances equal 1/8,2/15,1/6,8/15 and 1,76/75,16/15,124/75 in the specified order.
The OFAT expansion yields 10 axis variants, 280 unique cells, 40 zero-delta cells, 240 nonzero-delta cells and 1,400,000 simulated replicates.
Every axis_variant maps to exactly one specified tie/missing/support tuple; only BASE has all baseline axes and no pair of nonbaseline factors is combined.
Every authorized R is divisible by every support-cycle length.
The direction list contains exactly all 4*3 ordered pairs once, with no self-pair or duplicate.
K=7 cannot pass the first Holm threshold and K=8 can pass it only at W=8.
The endpoint algebra, bitmask mapping, root-count identities and opposite-direction W/L identities are executable assertions.

figure_2_contract.primary_message: Under the specified source-free root law, the complete 12-direction rule controls false directional selection and abstains when ties or missing roots remove arithmetic support; recovery varies with pair-specific standardized separation and root-support design.
figure_2_contract.control_basis: False-direction control follows analytically from independent-root stochastic domination under each rootwise strong null and the complete-family Holm procedure. Monte Carlo curves check the implementation and operating characteristics under the specified law; they do not prove empirical control or construction invariance.
figure_2_contract.source_data_requirement: Retain and release all 280 specified cells and every specified endpoint, including zero, failed and withheld states. Any main-panel subset or aggregation must be hash-bound before production execution and trace to the complete source table.
figure_2_contract.existing_negative_control_boundary: The hierarchical root/task/cell negative controls were defined after the earlier results had been inspected and remain separate inputs. They are not regenerated, resampled, pooled, averaged or counted in the 280-cell source-free operating grid or its 1,400,000-replicate denominator. Their axes and denominators must remain visually distinct.
figure_2_contract.main_panel_binding_required: F2_MAIN_PANEL_BINDING_V1.json must be byte-bound in the public amendment before production execution; no cell, endpoint, magnitude, root count, stress state, procedure or display aggregation outside that binding may be substituted after outcomes are inspected.
figure_2_contract.label_reflection_pooling_rule: Only where F2_MAIN_PANEL_BINDING_V1.json explicitly authorizes it, independently seeded +|delta| and -|delta| cells with otherwise identical specified settings are pooled under exact model-label-reversal symmetry. For a binary endpoint, sum the two event numerators, use denominator 10,000 and compute a two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval. For a specified bounded replicate-level edge score, concatenate the two 5,000-score vectors, report their 10,000-replicate mean and use the specified two-sided 95% Hoeffding formula with n=10,000. Release both signed 5,000-replicate cells separately. Pooling does not assert byte equality, paired seeds or exact observed endpoint equality.
must_show: global-null false-direction calibration with its fixed 5000-replicate denominator
exact-family recovery across delta and R, with the secondary all-edge average clearly subordinate and a note that nonadjacent edges have 2|delta| or 3|delta| mean separation
prespecified tie, missingness and root-support stress cells with complete-grid source-data linkage
all 20 pre-existing hierarchical root/task/cell negative-control rows, hash-bound before production and reported separately because they were defined after the earlier results had been inspected
pointwise Monte Carlo interval type and denominator
must_not_show: descendant task count as independent sample size
delta as one common effect size for all six unordered pairs
confidence intervals derived from roots instead of Monte Carlo replicates
a mechanistic difference claim from TIE010 versus MISS010 or TIE050 versus MISS050
support imbalance at constant information language for the specified heterogeneous support cycles
combined-nuisance robustness or interaction language from the OFAT-only grid
transport of M4/H12 recovery, abstention or Kmin values to M8 or multi-construction families
official benchmark, external validation, confirmatory or construction-invariant language
